data.long_description:
Modern 3-Bedroom Townhouse in Parkside | Emaar South, Dubai South

Welcome to this well-designed 3-bedroom townhouse located in the sought-after Parkside community at Emaar South, Dubai South. Offering 1,398 sq ft of thoughtfully planned living space, this home is ideal for families seeking comfort, functionality, and a peaceful community lifestyle.

Property Features:

-3 spacious bedrooms
-3 modern bathrooms
-1,398 sq ft built-up area
-Bright open-plan living and dining area
-Contemporary kitchen with ample storage
-Bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
-Master bedroom with ensuite bathroom
-Private garden / outdoor space
-Covered parking

Community Highlights:

-Family-friendly gated community
-Landscaped parks and walking trails
-Swimming pools and children’s play areas
-Community retail and dining options
-Close proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport
-Easy access to major road networks

Set within a master-planned community by Emaar, Parkside at Emaar South offers a relaxed lifestyle surrounded by greenery while remaining well connected to key destinations across Dubai.
